description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging within an ASP.NET Core application. It sets up MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, custom services, and JWT bearer authentication with token validation parameters.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for setting up services, JWT authentication, and logging in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures dependency injection for MediatR, behaviors, validators, AutoMapper, and custom services required by the application.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT bearer authentication, including signing keys, token validation parameters, and event handling for message reception.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
